task: Audit the proposed service configuration against the change policy. Determine whether config-proposed.json complies with every rule in policy.md relative to config-baseline.json, and report every violation.

shape.findings: list of {rule, service, explanation}, one entry per violation, sorted by rule id then service name; empty list when compliant

evidence_requirements: E-A: every reported violation cites the exact rule id and the exact service, with the concrete baseline/proposed values that establish it
E-B: every rule in policy.md is accounted for: either at least one violation is reported for it or it is confirmed satisfied across all services
E-C: the verdict follows mechanically from the findings (NONCOMPLIANT iff findings is non-empty)
verification_method: deterministic root verification per the preregistered method for this trial
